At game start, reads the latest version from the mod's SimpleRockets.com page and, if it's newer, offers to open the page. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
Writes thread positions and other details to Player.log.
With the modifier below, opens the Vizzy editor in flight. Pressed again, it applies the edit.
Shows a Vizzy button on the flight nav panel, with Restart Vizzy and Edit Vizzy. Applies from the next flight.

Adds Arrange MFD to the flight buttons: move, resize and rotate the widgets of a custom MFD program, then save the values into the program. Saving also changes the craft's files, after backing them up. Applies from the next flight.
Greatly increases the Vizzy editor's frame rate in large programs by pausing blocks far off screen. Off when another mod changes the editor.
Colors Funk fields and marks errors in red, in the designer and in flight.
Suggests Funk names while typing in a Funk field, in the designer and in flight. Up and Down choose, Enter takes it, Esc closes the list.
